notes.claim: When light enters a medium with a greater index of refraction, its speed is less there, and the ray bends towards the perpendicular.
The refractive index is the speed of light in empty space divided by its speed in the substance.
Snell's law links the two angles: the ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction.
The index of refraction of fresh water is listed as 1.333.
The critical angle is reached when the angle of refraction reaches 90 degrees.
